## 1. Product Categories & Technical Specifications

### A. Builder in a Bottle (BIAB) & Rubber Base Gel
- URL: https://gznewnail.com/oem/biab-rubber-base-gel-manufacturer.html
- Primary Use: Apex building, natural nail strengthening overlays, short extensions, ridge filling.
- Viscosity: 3,500 - 5,500 mPa.s (controlled self-leveling flow).
- Color Range: 50+ shades including Cover Pink, Milky White, Nude Beige, Sheer Peach, Jelly Rose, and Opal Shimmer.
- Formulations: Standard flexible resin, HEMA-Free, TPO-Free, and synthetic fiber-reinforced formulas.
- Curing Requirement: 60s under 48W/72W 365+405nm LED UV nail lamp.
- Removal: 10-15 minute acetone soak-off or e-file removal.
- Available Formats: 15ml customized retail bottles, 500ml HDPE refill bottles, 1KG bulk containers.

### B. Water-Permeable Halal Nail Polish
- URL: https://gznewnail.com/oem/halal-water-permeable-nail-polish-factory.html
- Technology: Micro-porous polymer matrix facilitating water vapor and liquid transmission for Wudu ritual compliance.
- Compliance: 100% Vegan, Cruelty-Free, Alcohol-Free, 15-Free clean cosmetic formula.
- Color Portfolio: 300+ shades (Creme, Nude, Pastel, Shimmer, Metallic, Glitter).
- Drying Time: 60 - 90 seconds air-dry without UV lamp.
- Packaging: 10ml, 12ml, 15ml high-clarity glass bottles with custom brush and cap options.

### C. UV/LED Gel Polish System
- URL: https://gznewnail.com/products/private-label-gel-polish/
- Core Categories: Pure Color Gel, Platinum Glitter Gel, Cat Eye Magnetic Gel, Blooming Gel, Jelly Tint Gel.
- Durability: 28+ days wear time without chipping or peeling.
- Safety: Low-odor, acid-free bonding, HEMA-Free option available.

### D. Functional Base & Top Gel Systems
- Base Coats: Thin Base Gel, Thick Rubber Base, Acid-Free Primer & Bonder, Fiber Base.
- Top Coats: No-Wipe Diamond High Gloss Top, Tempered Scratch-Resistant Top, Velvet Matte Top, Chrome Mirror Powder Sealer Top Coat.

### E. Acrylic & Dipping Powder Systems
- URL: https://gznewnail.com/products/acrylic-dipping-system/
- Polymers: Extra-fine sifted acrylic powder, buttery workability, non-yellowing optical brighteners.
- Monomer: 100% EMA (Ethyl Methacrylate) professional monomer liquid, zero MMA, low-odor all-season formula.
- Dipping Glue System: Step 1 Prep, Step 2 Base, Step 3 Activator, Step 4 Top, Brush Saver.

## 3. Quality Assurance, Testing & Compliance Standards

- Good Manufacturing Practice: ISO 22716:2007 Cosmetics GMP certified facility.
- Certificate Validity: Facility certificate issued September 19, 2026, valid through June 30, 2027.
- Laboratory Documentation: Comprehensive SDS (GHS format), COA (Certificate of Analysis) per production batch.
- Regulatory Compliance Support:
  - United States: FDA MoCRA facility registration and cosmetic product listing assistance.
  - European Union & United Kingdom: CPNP / SCPN cosmetic notification ingredient breakdown and CPSR formulation review.
- Testing Demonstrations: Water-permeability lab test video available upon request for Halal buyers.
